model_positioning: Empirical nonnegative L1 sparse allocation; shuffled ten-fold raw-risk lambda calibration followed by full-investment normalization. No hard invested-weight or future-risk guarantee.

cross_validation.criterion: absolute validation raw-coefficient variance error relative to sigma_daily squared
cross_validation.aggregation: mean of per-fold selected lambdas; largest lambda wins exact ties
cross_validation.zero_policy: record zero and failed solutions; select only investable nonzero fits
cross_validation.scope: estimation period only; shuffled folds reproduce the original procedure and are not chronological validation

eta_role: supplemental sensitivity; not lambda selection or the main model
